recordingTarget.manualDescription: The original text field could not be verified. Your result is saved in History. Use Copy there to paste it yourself.

callAgent.title: Selected-call agent access
callAgent.help: Share saved notes and transcript evidence from this call. Keep SS2 open while your agent uses the connection.
callAgent.sharedHelp: Agents can read this call and submit drafts. Revoking stops future access; copies already received remain with the agent.
callAgent.privateHelp: This call is private. Sharing grants access to its current and future saved notes and transcript.
callAgent.actionFailed: Could not complete this action. Check sharing, saved changes and the destination, then refresh and try again.
callAgent.filed: Saved a new Markdown copy. Existing files and source notes are unchanged.
callAgent.configHelp: Copy a configuration into your agent. These controls do not change external settings. Compatible with Codex and Claude Code; the JSON also works with MCP clients. Refresh configuration after moving SS2.
callAgent.handoffHelp: Review before pasting into an agent. This exports text only. Revocation cannot retract copied text. This one-time export does not require sharing or grant ongoing agent access.
callAgent.draftHelp: Drafts are separate from source notes. Review the proposal and its saved evidence before filing. Evidence may describe an older source version.
callAgent.noDrafts: No drafts yet. Ask your connected agent to submit a cited draft.
callAgent.chooseFolder: Choose a pinned folder below before filing.

speech.title: Local read-aloud
speech.unavailable: System voices are available on macOS
speech.help: Uses installed macOS voices. Text stays on this Mac. Recording stops read-aloud and replay audio.
speech.agentHelp: Off by default. Shared-call agents can speak brief updates only while recording is inactive. Revoking a call stops its agent speech.
speech.error: Could not complete the speech action. Check the voice settings and try again.
speech.readError: Select text in this section, or read the whole field. Text must fit within 20 KB; stop recording before reading.

historyHome.description: Find what you said. Pick up where you left off.
historyHome.searchHelp: Searches your full history, including original words before edits. ⌘/Ctrl F to focus.
historyHome.loadError: Could not load your history. Your saved dictations are still on this Mac.
historyHome.tryAnother: Try a different word or clear the search.
